descriptionOverview:
Turn your curiosity into a career. If you're passionate about artificial intelligence, eager to learn, and looking for a degree apprenticeship that combines academic study with exciting on-the-job experience, we'd love to hear from you.

Benefits of the programme:
Earn a salary while studying for your qualification
Gain hands-on experience in a real AI and engineering environment
Receive job-specific training and development
Achieve a recognised qualification
Secure a permanent role from the start of your apprenticeship
Have your university tuition fees fully paid

descriptionLearn:
Throughout the apprenticeship, you will gain experience and knowledge in:
Professional engineering behaviours, teamwork and industry best practice
Programming, software engineering, version control and automated testing
Data preparation, feature engineering and data quality techniques
Machine learning methods, model selection, training and evaluation
Deployment patterns, MLOps, monitoring and lifecycle management
Cloud, compute and development tools used to deliver AI solutions
Responsible AI, security, privacy, safety and regulatory considerations
Structured approaches to troubleshooting, experimentation and continuous improvement

descriptionQualifications:
To apply, you will need:
Highers:
96 UCAS points
Four Highers (BBCC) including Maths or Computing
A foundation apprenticeship will be equal to one Higher at B
A modern apprenticeship SCQF Level 6 in a relevant discipline will be equal to two Highers at B

To be considered for this position, you must have the permanent right to work in the UK and be able to successfully complete and maintain UK Government security checks, including Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) screening and Security Clearance (SC), which is a government background check, before starting employment.
